positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work closely with the Strategic Accounts team to identify root cause issues in software and identify and install solutions in software that is specific to the customer and to educate about and problem-solve issues with the software.
Provide technical assistance with the enhancement and development of specifications for customer-specific functionality.
Enhance current software offering based on customer-specific specifications.
Can support all RateLinx Products
Perform internal unit testing to ensure quality of the software.
Install and configure the software for the customer, ensuring the principles of security and availability are maintained at all times
Provide Go Live support to the customer in the use of the software.
Understand how shipments rate in the system and system functionality for the customer
Promptly and efficiently troubleshoot any issues that arise with the software.
Provide prompt phone and email technical assistance to customers for standard product offerings as needed.
Ensure that urgent needs are resolved immediately.
Provide prompt resolution of RateLinx Issue Tracker assignments.
Complete projects assigned by management by the assigned deadline.
Follows Specs and works with Account Managers on any code changes that are executed to spec update
Full knowledge of all software solutions for RateLinx and ability to troubleshoot and correct issues in real time for customers

positions.description: Responsibilities include unloading trucks, organizing boxes into their respective areas, and then stocking shelves. Also must be able to help guests and know where everything is.

positions.title: Cashier Customer Service
positions.description: This is a gas station affiliated with British Petroleum. I worked all shifts as it is both a truck stop and 24/7 gas station. Responsibilities included making food, making coffee, providing assistance to customers in the forms of suggestions, opinions, and directions, cleaning floors and shelves, sticking shelves, and cleaning bathrooms. This taught me to be alert for potential customers and to get what you can done when you can because you never know when there will e an interruption.

positions.title: Tarring and Sealing Technician
positions.description: Heavily physically demanding job with 10+ hour a day outdoors. Required mixing chemicals properly to create sealant, extended periods driving truck, and a majorly independent environment. Regular jobs required using push-fans to blow dust and dirt from the top we were to work on, an industrial torch to finish cracks, taring cracks, and then spraying down a coat of sealant. If one thing was done incorrectly you were forced to start all over. This taught me greater attention to little details on a macro level and doing jobs slowly and well.

positions.title: Employee
positions.description: Fast pace job setting out, cooking, and preparing food. We are trained for specific areas and are rotated every so often. Some positions require tables and spills to be cleaned, some require condiments and beverages to be kept stocked, some require dishes to be cleaned. Requires fast adaptability and compensation for others as well as teamwork to make sure everything is done quickly and efficiently.
